<?php
define('MAX', 511);
define('MOD', 998244353);
define('INV', 499122177);

function add($a, $b) {
    if ($a >= MOD) $a -= MOD;
    if ($b >= MOD) $b -= MOD;
    $a += $b;
    if ($a >= MOD) $a -= MOD;
    return $a;
}

function mult($a, $b) {
    $aa = $a;
    if ($aa >= MOD) $aa -= MOD;
    if ($b >= MOD) $b -= MOD;
    $aa *= $b;
    if ($aa >= MOD) $aa %= MOD;
    return $aa;
}

class FastScanner {
    private $BS = 1 << 16;
    private $NC = "\0";
    private $buf;
    private $bId = 0;
    private $size = 0;
    private $c = "\0";
    private $num = 1;
    private $in;

    public function __construct() {
        $this->buf = str_repeat("\0", $this->BS);
        $this->in = fopen('php://stdin', 'r');
    }

    public function nextChar() {
        if ($this->bId == $this->size) {
            $data = fread($this->in, $this->BS);
            if ($data === false || $data === '') {
                return $this->NC;
            }
            $this->size = strlen($data);
            $this->buf = $data;
            $this->bId = 0;
        }
        return $this->buf[$this->bId++];
    }

    public function nextInt() {
        return (int)$this->nextLong();
    }

    public function nextLong() {
        $this->num = 1;
        $neg = false;
        if ($this->c == $this->NC) $this->c = $this->nextChar();
        while (($this->c < '0' || $this->c > '9')) {
            if ($this->c == '-') $neg = true;
            $this->c = $this->nextChar();
        }
        $res = 0;
        while ($this->c >= '0' && $this->c <= '9') {
            $res = ($res << 3) + ($res << 1) + (ord($this->c) - ord('0'));
            $this->num *= 10;
            $this->c = $this->nextChar();
        }
        return $neg ? -$res : $res;
    }
}

function main() {
    $fs = new FastScanner();
    $n = $fs->nextInt();
    $k = $fs->nextInt();
    
    if ($n == 1) {
        echo 0 . "\n";
        return;
    }
    
    $dp = array_fill(0, MAX, array_fill(0, MAX, 0));
    $dp[1][1] = 2;
    
    for ($pos = 0; $pos < $n; $pos++) {
        $ndp = array_fill(0, MAX, array_fill(0, MAX, 0));
        
        $limit = min($k, $n);
        for ($i = 1; $i <= $limit; $i++) {
            for ($j = 1; $j <= $limit; $j++) {
                $nm = max($i, $j + 1);
                $ndp[$nm][$j + 1] = add($ndp[$nm][$j + 1], $dp[$i][$j]);
                $ndp[$i][1] = add($ndp[$i][1], $dp[$i][$j]);
            }
        }
        
        if ($pos != $n - 1) {
            $dp = $ndp;
        }
    }
    
    $nums = array_fill(0, MAX, 0);
    $div2 = array_fill(0, MAX, 0);
    
    $limit = min($n, $k);
    for ($i = 1; $i <= $limit; $i++) {
        for ($j = 1; $j <= $limit; $j++) {
            $nums[$i] = add($nums[$i], $dp[$i][$j]);
        }
    }
    
    for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
        $div2[$i] = mult($nums[$i], INV);
    }
    
    $res = 0;
    for ($i = 1; $i <= $limit; $i++) {
        for ($j = 1; $j <= $limit; $j++) {
            if ($i * $j < $k) {
                $res = add($res, mult(2, mult($div2[$i], $div2[$j])));
            }
        }
    }
    
    echo $res . "\n";
}

main();

source_data.prob_desc_description: You are given a square board, consisting of $$$n$$$ rows and $$$n$$$ columns. Each tile in it should be colored either white or black.Let's call some coloring beautiful if each pair of adjacent rows are either the same or different in every position. The same condition should be held for the columns as well.Let's call some coloring suitable if it is beautiful and there is no rectangle of the single color, consisting of at least $$$k$$$ tiles.Your task is to count the number of suitable colorings of the board of the given size.Since the answer can be very large, print it modulo $$$998244353$$$.
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: Print a single integer — the number of suitable colorings of the board of the given size modulo $$$998244353$$$.
